thread_text:
maya: Putting together the internal release note and blast for v2.3.1. Change window Sat 23:00 UTC. Need: 1-line blurb, exact deploybot commands, header pin, ops checklist, and a tiny support FAQ. Who can own the blast?

nina: I can own it. Will draft RN bullets and a short internal blurb, post link here in ~30m.

lee: Canary plan suggestion: 10% (20m) -> 40% (20m) -> 100% (20m). Health gates: error_rate > 1.5% over 5m OR p95 latency delta > 90ms -> pause + investigate. OOM spikes = immediate pause + rollback.

juan: Add OOM_count > 0 as a hard trigger. Also ask SRE to watch GPU memory alloc spikes during the first stage.

hiro: Draft blurb idea: "v2.3.1: KV-cache correctness, streaming token efficiency (~10% token cost savings), and quant patch to reduce tail latencies. Canary tonight; oncall: @lee @juan." Short and plain.

deploybot: Scheduled deploy: v2.3.1 canary start=2024-11-07T23:00:00Z. Suggested command: `/deploy v2.3.1 --canary=10% --stages=40%,100% --stage-duration=20m` 

nina: Nice. I'll include the exact command lines and a copy/paste ops checklist (pause, rollback, pin) in the RN. Also putting the Dedicated pin header and SDK examples.

lee: Rollback runbook (one-liner bullets for RN):
1) Pause: `/deploybot pause --id {{deploy_id}}`
2) Rollback: `/deploybot rollback --to v2.3.0`
3) Pin back if needed: `curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/pins -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' -d '{"runtime":"rif-runtime@3c7f"}'`
4) Notify #eng-oncall + CSMs.

opsbot: Automation rules stored for this deploy: error_rate > 1.5% (5m), p95_delta > 90ms (5m), oom_count > 0 (2m). Auto-rollback requires two rules firing or an immediate OOM.

nina: Pin header for Dedicated customers: `x-rw-runtime: rif-runtime@3c7f`. SDK example for Node: `client.setHeader('x-rw-runtime','rif-runtime@3c7f')`. Curl example: `curl -H \"x-rw-runtime: rif-runtime@3c7f\" https://api.redwood.ai/generate`

hiro: Add a short 'what we tested' line in RN: staging smoke (2k tokens/min streaming for 15m), quant regression evals, 32GB GPU mem checks.

maya: Micro-FAQ for support to include in RN:
Q: How do I pin runtime?
A: Header `x-rw-runtime: rif-runtime@3c7f` or Console -> Runtime pins.
Q: How to rollback?
A: Use `/deploybot rollback --to v2.3.0` or ping #eng-oncall.

lee: Observability quick-queries to paste in RN: `sum(rate(runtime_errors[5m]))` and `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))`. Also a GPU memory grafana panel link.

nina: Posted draft: https://rwd.internal/releases/drafts/v2.3.1-internal-rn (please review). Planning internal announce at 22:40 UTC (20m before window) unless objections.

juan: I'll be primary oncall for the window. Lee backup. Added both to the RN.

maya: One note: avoid customer-facing blasts between 00:00-06:00 UTC. We'll schedule customer comms after we confirm rollout. Internal only pre-window.

opsbot: Blackout enforcement: deploybot will block if outside allowed windows. Manual override flagged required for any blackout run.

lee: Include a small 'fast rollback indicators' list in RN: OOM logs, error spikes (>1.5%), p95 up by >90ms, sudden increase in retry rates.

nina: Done. I tightened the blurb for the internal announce and added the code snippets (copy/paste ready). Final review at 22:30 UTC.

maya: Staging smoke now; reporting in 15m. If green, Nina can send blast.

deploybot: Canary started (10%) -> monitoring hooks enabled. Good luck! :rocket:
